system/0402_btl_main.txt.560: The user stirs up a fairy wind and\nstrikes the target with it.
system/0402_btl_main.txt.561: Letting out a charming cry, the user does\nemotional damage to opposing Pokémon.\nThis attack never misses.
system/0402_btl_main.txt.562: The user steals the target's HP with a\nkiss. The user's HP is restored by over\nhalf of the damage taken by the target.
system/0402_btl_main.txt.563: The user damages opposing Pokémon by\nemitting a powerful flash.
system/0402_btl_main.txt.564: The user plays rough with the target\nand attacks it. This may also lower the\ntarget's Attack stat.
